blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — Starhorse Shipping Lines Inc. has suspended the acceptance and carriage of electric vehicles (EVs) and hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs) across its fleet, making it the third marine service fleet to raise safety concerns following the September 9 fire on a boat bound for Palawan. In a Sept. 18 advisory, Starhorse president Vincent Dominic Reyes said the suspension would take effect immediately and remain in place until further notice as a precautionary measure to protect passengers, crew and vessels during inter-island travel. The shipping line said lithium batteries used in EVs and hybrid vehicles, including plug-in hybrids, pose risks […]...
